dimensions.label: the overallintent
dimensions.description: meme-id: jews_and_americans_will_ruin_the_world; hasOverallIntent: hateful; overall-intent-description: The image depicts a person wearing a kippah (a Jewish head covering) with the Star of David, standing with their back to the viewer in front of an American flag. The text overlay reads 'jews and americans will ruin the world.' This meme uses visual juxtaposition to imply a conspiratorial or conspiratorial-like association between Jewish people and Americans, suggesting they are collectively responsible for global problems. This is a harmful and hateful stereotype rooted in antisemitic tropes, particularly the 'Jewish-American conspiracy' myth, which falsely accuses Jewish people of controlling global institutions and causing societal decay. The meme is intended to incite prejudice and hostility toward both Jewish and American identities, making it a direct hateful attack on these communities based on ethnicity and nationality.
